purpose: Development fixtures for routing, policy and future adapter integration; not training data or an independent holdout.

conventions.scope: Expected upstream-resolved scope; not parsed by keyword baseline.
conventions.task_params: Illustrative operations/metric codes require team approval.
conventions.final_status: Post-policy/execution expectation, distinct from the route. Full statuses are outside RouterOutput MVP.
conventions.evidence: All source IDs, hashes, values and companies prefixed MOCK are synthetic, never verified LIVE evidence.
conventions.default_mocks: Absent response means unspecified; do not infer executable success.
conventions.no_search: Non-SEARCH cases must not call GRAPH/CONTENT; existing market/reference handlers may perform their own operations.
conventions.as_of: 31/12/2025 is explicit in graph questions; do not infer relation dates from a year alone.
conventions.evaluation: Score baseline only on classifier_evaluation.eligible resolved inputs. Repeated fault scenarios are not independent language samples.
conventions.holdout: These fixtures are visible during development. Freeze a separate unseen acceptance set before claiming generalization.
